gaps.description: intake.schema.json enforces ordinal >= 2 (assuming line 1 CSV header) and unique (snapshot_id, ordinal). Single-page wikitext snapshots have no CSV header, so ordinal=2 is recorded for the whole pinned wikitext revision file while line spans record 1..N.

intake.schema.json has no dedicated columns for MediaWiki pageid, revid, revision_timestamp, wikitext_sha256, permalink_url, history_url, or dual-license notice (GFDL). These are stored deterministically in edition_json / locator_json and snapshots/snapshots_manifest.json.

Structured scope proposals (written, catholicism) remain outcome='needs_review' with open SCOPE_QUALIFIER_REQUIRES_REVIEW findings and scopes.csv state='unknown'; core pack L3 promotion admits only the 31 receipt-approved headword, POS, and definition/gloss claims.
